content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Nurse-II: Three year General Nursing and Midwife (GNM) Course. Previous experience in handling clinical research projects related to medical field, basic knowledge about antimicrobials, interpretation of patient file and culture reports, knowledge of Microsoft excel, word, Power point and other internet programs, well-versed in local languages (Rajasthani and Hindi) and English, knowledge and experience of REDCap usage will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse-II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Nurse-II, which is a project-based healthcare position under an ICMR-sponsored project at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Nurse-II position at AIIMS Jodhpur as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year General Nursing and Midwife (GNM) Course diploma to be eligible for the Project Nurse-II position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Nurse-II post is 35 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this criteria before attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Nurse-II position will receive a monthly salary of INR 24,000 as per the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. You need to carry your filled application form, original documents, and self-attested photocopies to the venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Nurse-II position is scheduled to be held on 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Project Nurse-II recruitment at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the interview?
faq.answer: You must carry your original educational certificates, experience certificates, a passport-size photograph, and a duly filled application form along with self-attested photocopies of all documents.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of an interview. However, a screening test may be conducted by the authorities if a large number of candidates appear for the walk-in.
